objects.description: [UNC3886](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1048) has used the TABLEFLIP traffic redirection utility and the esxcli command line to modify firewall rules.(Citation: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence ESXi VIBs 2022)(Citation: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence VMWare ESXi Zero-Day 2023)(Citation: Mandiant Fortinet Zero Day)
objects.description_fa: [UNC3886](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1048) از ابزار تغییر مسیر ترافیک TABLEFLIP و خط فرمان esxcli برای اصلاح قوانین دیوار آتش استفاده کرده است.(Citation: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence ESXi VIBs 2022)(Citation: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence VMWare ESXi Zero-Day 2023)[[CTI_PRESERVE_2] (Citation: Mandiant Fortinet Zero Day)
